header.rule: Matching a rank on the table captures it -- but an opponent's won bundle has a weak spot: its top card. Play a card of that rank and you take the whole bundle. You cannot place a card while a capture is available; you take from the table or you take a bundle. The card you play becomes the top of your own bundle, so that is what gets aimed at next. Most cards at the end wins.

tutorial.rule: **Matching a rank on the table captures it.** The cards you take and the card you played all go onto your own bundle.
tutorial.steal: **An opponent's bundle has a weak spot: its top card.** Play a card of that rank and you take **the whole bundle** — this game lets you attack cards that are already scored.
tutorial.mustCapture: **You cannot place a card while a capture is available.** Take from the table or take a bundle. Whatever you play becomes the top of your own bundle, so that is what gets aimed at next.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Select a card and only the moves it can actually make are offered.
